supported_claims.text: V0 shows a plain light-colored kitchen cloth being taken from the cupboard and then returned; the released pixels do not support a more specific print label.

V1 shows a different light-background reusable kitchen hand towel with visible green/gray darker areas and tan/brown lines being used to dry both hands. The cloth stays folded and wrinkled; the exact print theme and unique design are not established.
The two cloths have different HD-EPIC association IDs, and the second remains in use after the first cloth is returned.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent retain the correctly bound spare-item choice when later visual activity makes a different object salient?
construct.belief_before: V0 shows the initial pale kitchen cloth being taken from and returned to the cupboard.
construct.belief_after: V0 shows the initial pale kitchen cloth being taken from and returned to the cupboard. V1 shows a different, patterned towel being used for hand drying. The earlier request remains about the initial pale towel.
construct.required_behavior_change: Keep a selection satisfying the initially requested physical type. Do not replace it solely because another object is handled later.
construct.no_update_failure: No update is required for a correct initial selection; the unchanged request remains satisfiable without V1.
construct.overupdate_failure: Replacing the requested original item with a later, non-equivalent object leaves the earlier request unfulfilled.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The wording supplies no blade class, dispenser mechanism or exact scene-derived item type; V0 identifies the requested physical referent. V0 shows the initial pale kitchen cloth being taken from and returned to the cupboard. V1 shows a different, patterned towel being used for hand drying. The earlier request remains about the initial pale towel.

task_blueprint.instruction: Add a spare kitchen hand towel matching the one I have just taken out of the cupboard. Match the main colour; any brand, material or pack size is fine.
task_blueprint.completion_claim: Exactly one cart listing supplies a supported replacement for the object identified when the request is spoken; later unrelated handling does not change that request.
